visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with the male creator standing on a wooden deck outside a house, wearing a white graphic t-shirt and grey patterned shorts. He faces the camera directly, speaking with animated facial expressions and wide hand gestures, introducing his 100-day weight loss plan. Large orange and white text overlays appear on the screen to indicate the progress. (2) He introduces a black handheld massage gun, demonstrating its use on his neck and shoulders while making exaggerated expressions of relief. He brings the device closer to the camera to show its compact design and rotating head. The background shows a wooden storage cabinet and sliding screen doors. (3) He moves to step onto a digital body composition scale placed on the deck. The camera switches to a top-down close-up view of the scale's interface, showing numbers for weight, body fat, and visceral fat as the device processes. He reacts to the results with surprised and relieved expressions. (4) In a bright indoor kitchen, the creator prepares a healthy meal. He is seen chopping stinky tofu, cabbage, and chicken breast on a brown cutting board. A woman in a black shirt briefly appears, pinching her nose and showing a disgusted expression due to the smell of the tofu. (5) The scene shifts to night, where the creator is exercising outdoors on a blue mat. He is shown performing stretches, push-ups, and lifting a heavy kettlebell. A white and black dog lies nearby on the ground. The lighting is dim with artificial garden lights. (6) Finally, the creator is back at a table preparing a late-night snack of bamboo shoots. He slices the shoots and arranges them on a plate with wasabi and soy sauce. He eats a piece and reacts to the sharp pungency of the wasabi before signing off.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young male with short black hair and glasses, wearing a white graphic t-shirt and grey patterned shorts, later changing into a dark athletic shirt and black shorts for exercise.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: An outdoor wooden deck with storage cabinets and a screen door; a modern indoor kitchen with white cabinetry and appliances; an outdoor night area with grass and exercise equipment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, upbeat electronic pop music starts with a strong percussive beat. The male speaker's voice is high-arousal and clear, introducing his diet plan. Minimal background outdoor ambiance. (2) A sharp mechanical buzzing sound from the massage gun overlaps with the speaker's vocal track. The music maintains a constant volume while short 'pop' sound effects punctuate visual text changes. (3) Sound shifts to a metallic click and soft thuds as he interacts with the body scale. A brief high-pitched notification chime is heard from the scale. (4) Ambiance changes to indoor kitchen sounds, including the crisp chopping of a knife on a board and the rustle of plastic bags. A female voice is heard briefly expressing a high-pitched exclamation of disgust. (5) Bubbling liquid and metallic clinking of a pot lid are audible. The BGM remains upbeat. Strategic slurping sounds occur as the creator eats his meal. (6) Transition to night ambiance with faint cricket sounds. Rhythmic thumping and heavy breathing are captured during the exercise sequence, punctuated by the metallic 'clank' of the kettlebell. (7) Final segment features crisp crunching sounds of eating and a final vocal sign-off as the music tracks swell slightly before a hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Progress Check -> Routine Activities -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a daily check-in for a long-term weight loss challenge, combining progress reporting, product demonstration, healthy cooking, and physical exercise to engage viewers interested in fitness and lifestyle transformation.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator specifically demonstrates the massage gun, mentions its price, and shows his social media handles nearby, suggesting a promotional collaboration.
